levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
عبد الرحمن بن كعب بن مالك

notes: «- أو عبد الله بن كعب -» is the narrator's own «or» at the same position: two alternatives in one level, not an editor gloss.
«أبيه، كعب» is one man (rule 7): the link is كعب, the father's name.
«حدثنا أبي» is the speaker's father with no name: a relation link.
